page_title: FRA 2-0 MOR | France v Morocco 14/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco) inside the box.
90+4' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) takes it short.
90+4' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Morocco earn a corner.
90+3' Ez Abde (Morocco) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90+2' Kylian Mbappe (France) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
88' The attendance for today's match is 68294.
87' The foul by Marcus Thuram (France) was seen by Cesar Arturo Ramos who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
87' The ball is cleared after Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.

87' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
85' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
84' Ibrahima Konate (France) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Morocco.
82' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for an infringement.
79' 2 - 0 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (France) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 2:0.
79' A great run by Kylian Mbappe (France) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
78' Didier Deschamps has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Randal Kolo Muani (France) replacing Ousmane Dembele.
78' Substitution. Selim Amallah walks off the pitch and Ez Abde (Morocco) comes on as a substitute.

78' Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and France will have a goal kick.
77' A long pass, executed by Raphael Varane (France), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
76' Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
75' 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
75' Selim Amallah (Morocco) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Youssouf Fofana (France) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Marcus Thuram and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
72' Marcus Thuram (France) makes a good run to latch onto the free kick from Antoine Griezmann, but pushes his close-range header well past the right post.
71' Antoine Griezmann (France) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
71' Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle after Achraf Dari (Morocco) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Another situation results in a direct free kick for France.
69' Kylian Mbappe (France) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
69' The free kick is taken by Antoine Griezmann (France), but ball is cleared.
69' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows for a foul. France have a free kick.
67' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) sends a chip pass into the box, but Hugo Lloris is quickest to intercept the ball.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sofiane Boufal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco).
66' Walid Regragui prepares a substitution. Youssef En Nesyri is replaced by Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco).
65' Substitution. Marcus Thuram (France) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Olivier Giroud walks off.
64' Ousmane Dembele (France) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
63' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
63' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
62' Morocco are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
61' Poor challenge! Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) is penalised for tripping and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle.
60' Kylian Mbappe (France) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
59' A pass by Youssouf Fofana (France) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
58' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for France.
55' Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) releases Achraf Hakimi with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
54' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
52' Kylian Mbappe (France) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
52' Kylian Mbappe (France) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
51' Kylian Mbappe (France) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Hakim Ziyech (Morocco).
50' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
48' Antoine Griezmann (France) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Kylian Mbappe, but Bono displays great awareness to stop him.
48' Jules Kounde (France) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
47' A cross by Kylian Mbappe (France) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
46' Walid Regragui has decided to substitute Noussair Mazraoui and he is replaced by Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco).
46' Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
45+3' Referee Cesar Arturo Ramos sees the trip by Youssouf Fofana (France) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Morocco have been awarded a free kick.
45+1' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) launches a cross from the corner, but Hugo Lloris is alert to thwart the effort.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' Hugo Lloris makes a sensational save to thwart a huge chance. A rebound falls to Jawad El Yamiq (Morocco) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper manages to dive and punch the ball onto the post and away.
44' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

44' Good clearance! Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players. Morocco have a corner.
43' Jules Kounde (France) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Morocco will have a goal kick.

40' Raphael Varane (France) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
40' Antoine Griezmann (France) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
39' Antoine Griezmann (France) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. France win a corner.
37' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) brings his opponent down. Cesar Arturo Ramos has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
37' The total number of attempts is 8:3.
36' Aurelien Tchouameni plays a lovely pass into Olivier Giroud (France), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.

35' Youssouf Fofana (France) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
34' Antoine Griezmann (France) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
34' Antoine Griezmann (France) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
33' Aurelien Tchouameni (France) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
32' Selim Amallah (Morocco) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
31' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
29' Selim Amallah (Morocco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Theo Hernandez (France) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
28' Theo Hernandez (France) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
26' Ousmane Dembele (France) is penalised for holding. Cesar Arturo Ramos signals a set piece.
26' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
26' 43:57 – the latest ball possession ratio.
25' Ibrahima Konate (France) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Morocco are awarded a free kick.
23' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Problems for Walid Regragui as Romain Saiss (Morocco) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Selim Amallah replaces him.
20' Kylian Mbappe (France) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Cesar Arturo Ramos who sees an offensive foul.
20' France keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
19' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends a cross into the box, but Hugo Lloris comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Olivier Giroud (France) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
16' A short pass from Sofiane Boufal puts Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails well wide of the right post.
15' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
15' Cesar Arturo Ramos interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Youssouf Fofana (France). Morocco have a free kick.
13' Antoine Griezmann (France) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman signals a throw-in for Morocco.
11' Kylian Mbappe (France) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

10' A sweet pass finds Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Hugo Lloris is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
8' Kylian Mbappe (France) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Theo Hernandez (France) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 1:0.

5' Kylian Mbappe (France) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
3' Morocco are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
1' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
